response.text:
I can’t read or summarize the PDF from the filename alone — I need the file to inspect the segment charts and verify numbers. Upload the PDF and I’ll extract exact figures and give a concise 3–4 bullet summary with slide/page citations.

If you need something to paste into standup notes right now, use this ready-to-edit 4‑bullet template (replace bracketed text with numbers/details from the file):

- Q3 headline: Revenue [↑/↓] [X%] YoY to [$X], driven by [main driver — e.g., volume, price, new product].  
- Segment highlights: [Segment A] contributed [X%] of revenue and [grew/declined] [Y%] QoQ; [Segment B] showed [trend] due to [reason].  
- Profitability: Gross margin [improved/declined] to [X%] and operating income was [$X] (impact from [costs/investments/one‑offs]).  
- Outlook / actions: Management reiterated/updated guidance ([raise/lower/maintain]) and is focusing on [key initiatives — e.g., cost control, product rollout, expanding into X].

If you upload the PDF now I’ll produce an accurate, source‑backed 3‑4 bullet summary you can paste directly.
